summary: @servicetitan/notifications preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an undeclared obfuscated bundle
details: The package advertises itself as a React notifications UI but declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` identifiers, proxy objects, indirect calls) and, on `npm install`, selects a platform-specific Bun archive, downloads it from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<variant>.zip to a temp directory, extracts it, chmods the binary executable, and invokes that Bun binary on a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotating string-array obfuscation, hex-named identifiers) sitting at the tarball root; it is not listed in package.json `files` (which declares only `dist` and `src`) and is not reachable from the normal require graph. Fetching an alternate language runtime specifically to execute an undeclared, obfuscated bundle unrelated to the package's stated frontend purpose runs attacker-controlled code on every installer's machine at install time and bypasses scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
